story.fullStory:
Madonna's "Ray Of Light" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. Ray of Light is the seventh studio album by American singer-songwriter Madonna, released on February 22, 1998, by Maverick Records.

A major stylistic and aesthetic departure from her previous work, Bedtime Stories (1994), Ray of Light is an electronica, trip hop, techno-pop, and new-age record that incorporates multiple genres, including ambient, house, rock, and classical.

Mystical themes feature prominently in the music and lyrics, reflecting Madonna's embrace of Kabbalah, her study of Hinduism and Buddhism, and her daily practice of Ashtanga yoga.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
